proposals.before: In the first year of Xianfeng he was made Plain White Mongol commander; when censors accused Qishan of slaughter in the Qinghai fan campaign, Sa Ying'a was sent to Xining to investigate.
proposals.after: In the first year of Xianfeng he was made Plain White Manchu Banner commander; when censors accused Qishan of slaughter in the Qinghai fan campaign, Sa Ying'a was sent to Xining to investigate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 正白旗滿洲都統 is Plain White Manchu Banner commander; the idiomatic English wrongly says Mongol.

proposals.before: In the first year of Xianfeng [1851], he was summoned and appointed Mongol commander of the Plain White Banner; joining Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan in suppressing Qinghai fan bandits, censors impeached Qishan for indiscriminate killing, and Sa Ying'a was ordered to Xining to investigate.
proposals.after: In the first year of Xianfeng [1851], he was summoned and appointed Manchu commander of the Plain White Banner; when Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan was suppressing Qinghai fan bandits, censors impeached Qishan for indiscriminate killing, and Sa Ying'a was ordered to Xining to investigate.
proposals.reason: Chinese specifies 滿洲 (Manchu), not Mongol; the literal English mistranslates the banner affiliation.

decisions.reason: s0122 reads 召授正白旗滿洲都統: the office is Manchu (滿洲) Plain White Banner commander, not Mongol. The proposed idiomatic replacement corrects that error without other changes.

s0122 has 滿洲都統, so Mongol is wrong; 會陝甘總督琦善剿青海番匪 marks the concurrent Qinghai campaign when censors impeached Qishan, not Sa Ying'a joining that campaign. The proposed Manchu wording and when-clause fix both errors accurately.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 召授正白旗滿洲都統，會陝甘總督琦善剿青海番匪，言官劾其妄殺
